description.zh: 新的资源组ID，可在资源组控制台查看可用资源组。
description.en: The ID of the new resource group. You can find the IDs of active resource groups in the Resource Group console.

description.zh: 资源类型的ID标识符。例如，当ResourceType=cluster时，则ResourceId可以理解为ClusterId。
description.en: The ID of the resource. For example, if ResourceType is set to \`cluster\`, this parameter specifies the cluster ID.
The resource type. Only \`cluster\` is supported.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adcp change-resource-group --resource-id c9603ee23a84a41d6a1424619cb800000 --resource-type cluster --new-resource-group-id rg-aekzlvgbhaca000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun adcp ChangeResourceGroup --region cn-hangzhou --NewResourceGroupId 'rg-aekzlvgbhaca000' --ResourceId c9603ee23a84a41d6a1424619cb800000 --ResourceType cluster
